title: Retrying a payment with the same Idempotency-Key returns 409 and the payment is stuck
details:
Reported by the integration team at Harbour Point.

Their client posts to /v1/payments with an Idempotency-Key. When the first request times out on their
side they retry with the same key and the same payment, which is exactly what our documentation tells
them to do. They are getting back:

    409 {"error": {"code": "idempotency_conflict",
                   "message": "idempotency key 'key-1' was already used for a different request"}}

It is not a different request. It is the same merchant, the same amount, the same currency. Their retry
is built by re-serialising the payment object, so the JSON fields can come out in a different order from
the first attempt, but every value is identical.

The effect is that a payment they cannot confirm is one they can also never complete — the key is burned
and they have to mint a new one and hope they are not charging the customer twice.

A retry that is byte-identical works. A retry with the same content in a different field order does not.
